Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. At Slalom, we believe that together, we can move faster, dream bigger, and build better tomorrows for all.
Who You’ll Work With
At Slalom, we co-create custom software, data, AI, and cloud solutions with clients who are ready to accelerate their digital transformation. We are passionate about technology and its potential to create better products, experiences, and organizations.

title: Machine Learning Performance Engineer
reason: Stack +54; Title fit +12; Title stack +10; Exp fit +10; US +10
description_preview:
Goliath is partnered with an established quantitative trading firm seeking an engineer to improve the performance of machine learning models in production.
Working within its central engineering group, you’ll tackle the hardware and software challenges behind fast, reliable inference. The work combines hands-on GPU optimization with broader decisions about how and where models should run, alongside specialists in machine learning, computing infrastructure, and hardware acceleration.
They are currently looking for a Machine Learning Performance Engineer based in New York.
Write and tune GPU kernels to accelerate production inference
Investigate performance bottlenecks, from memory access patterns to communication between hardware components
Reduce model size and computational demands while preserving numerical stability
Compare hardware options and help determine the best deployment approach for demanding trading workloads
Partner with researchers and engineering teams to bring optimized models into production
Essential Skills
2+ years improving deep learning inference performance in production environments where speed or throughput is critical
Strong Python and C++, with experience working beneath the high-level APIs of frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX
Practical experience developing custom GPU kernels and using inference optimization tools
Detailed knowledge of GPU execution, memory behavior, and mixed-precision computation
A measurement-driven approach to profiling systems and comparing performance across different hardware architectures
Preferred Skills
Experience deploying or optimizing models on FPGAs or ASICs
Familiarity with inference workloads where individual predictions must be delivered with exceptionally low latency
Candidates from outside financial services are welcome; trading experience is not required.
Compensation
$200K–$300K base salary plus discretionary bonus
Would this interest you? If so, apply & Goliath will be in contact!

title: Machine Learning Enginee
reason: Stack +57; Synergy +10; Title fit +12; Title stack +10; US +10
description_preview:
Role Description
This is a part-time, remote Machine Learning Engineer role at SG Academy. The position focuses on designing, implementing, and evaluating machine learning models to support educational products, tools, and platforms. Day-to-day responsibilities include building and optimizing algorithms, experimenting with neural network architectures, and applying pattern recognition techniques to real-world datasets. The Machine Learning Engineer will collaborate with instructors, product teams, and developers to translate learning objectives into data-driven features, improve existing models, and document solutions for reproducibility and knowledge sharing. The role also involves code reviews, performance monitoring, and staying current with emerging machine learning methods and best practices.
Qualifications
Strong foundation in Computer Science and Algorithms, with the ability to design efficient, scalable solutions.
Applied knowledge of Statistics and Pattern Recognition to analyze data, evaluate model performance, and draw meaningful insights.
Hands-on experience with Neural Networks and modern machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).
Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in machine learning (such as Python), including version control and testing practices.
Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage part-time hours effectively, and communicate clearly with cross-functional teams.
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience with data preprocessing, model deployment, and cloud-based ML tools (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure) is beneficial.
Interest in education technology and improving learning experiences through data-driven innovation is a plus.

description_preview:
Join Us, and Ship Robots
Weave was founded to build the robots we’d want to have in our own home. We believe the next generation of robotics will transform everyday life by enabling people to do more and to reclaim time to spend on what’s important.
We also believe robots are in a sense like any other product: to matter, they have to ship. Our robots are already operating in real homes and businesses, giving us the opportunity to rapidly improve from real-world experience. With a growing team, strong customer demand, and capital for expansion, we’re entering an exciting stage of growth—and we’re looking for people with exceptional talent and standards to help bring home robotics to millions of households.
The Role
Weave builds and deploys some of the first bimanual robots operating in customer homes. On and off the robot sits an entire stack that makes the whole fleet run 24/7: on-robot drivers and services, streaming and telemetry, cloud backend, inference infrastructure, and the apps customers interact with every day. You'll build across all of it. One week it's a customer-facing feature in the app, the next it's the backend that serves it, the next it's the on-robot service that feeds it data.
This is a role without lanes. You'll work with Specialists across the stack, but you'll own making the robot's capabilities reach the people and systems that need them. This will involve reading, debugging, and shipping code at any layer to do it.
Responsibilities
Ship features end to end: from data originating on the robot, through backend services, to pixels on a customer's screen, owning every layer in between.
Build customer applications: web, mobile, and the real-time interfaces (live video, robot state, control) that make a robot in your home feel legible and trustworthy.
Build the fleet backend: telemetry ingestion, remote operations tooling, deployment infrastructure, and the services that keep a growing fleet observable and supportable.
Work on the robot when the problem lives there: instrument a service, fix the API you're consuming, or extend an on-robot component instead of filing a ticket and waiting.
Accelerate the team: building teleoperation consoles, data browsers, and ops dashboards. A quick prototype you build in an afternoon can change how fast the rest of the company moves.
What You'll Bring
3+ years shipping production software across at least two of: frontend/mobile, backend services, infrastructure, systems software.
Language range: strong in TypeScript and Python or Go, able to read and modify C++ or Rust when the bug is on the robot.
Distributed systems fundamentals: API design, streaming data, WebSockets or gRPC, databases, and failure modes of networked hardware.
Infrastructure competence: cloud deployment, containers, CI/CD, and observability you set up yourself.
Debugging range: you follow a bug across service boundaries, languages, and machines until you find it, not until it leaves your area.
Cross-functional experience: you keep app, robot, hardware, and ML teams moving by diving into system-wide issues and resolving boundary questions at a whiteboard, not over tickets.
Product judgment: you can take a one-line request from a customer and ship the right thing without a spec.
Nice to Have
Experience with low-latency and robust video streams.
3D visualization: Three.js, WebGL, Unity.
Robotics, consumer hardware, or connected-hardware products in production.
Security depth: OAuth/OIDC, token design, secure APIs for physical devices.
VR or teleoperation interface work.

As a modern technology company, our Slalom Technologists are disrupting the market and bringing to life the art of the possible for our clients. We have passion for building strategies, solutions, and creative products to help our clients solve their most complex and interesting business problems. We surround our technologists with interesting challenges, innovative minds, and emerging technologies.
Job Title:
Enterprise - Salesforce Agentforce Developer
Slalom is seeking an experienced Enterprise AI Developer to help design, build, and implement AI-enabled solutions across Salesforce and other enterprise business applications. This role is ideal for a hands-on developer who is excited about applying Generative AI, Agentforce, automation, and modern development practices to solve meaningful client challenges.
In this role, you will work as part of cross-functional delivery teams to build proof of concepts, production-ready capabilities, integrations, and reusable patterns that help clients adopt AI responsibly and effectively. You will collaborate with architects, consultants, developers, and client stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable, maintainable technical solutions.
The ideal candidate brings strong Salesforce development experience, curiosity about emerging AI technologies, and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience with Agentforce, Prompt Builder, Data Cloud, RAG patterns, or cloud-based AI platforms is highly valued, but we also value candidates who are actively learning and applying these capabilities.
This position offers an exciting opportunity for a results-driven technologist who enjoys hands-on development, collaborative problem solving, and delivering practical AI solutions that create real business impact.

Build and configure AI-enabled Salesforce solutions, including Agentforce capabilities, prompt-based experiences, automation, integrations, and supporting components.
Contribute as an individual developer on active client engagements, partnering closely with architects, consultants, and other developers.
Help create POCs, POVs, and reusable examples that demonstrate how AI can be applied within Salesforce and across other enterprise platforms.
Translate business requirements into well-structured technical solutions with support from solution architects and delivery leads.
Develop using Salesforce technologies such as Apex, Lightning Web Components, JavaScript, flows, APIs, and related platform capabilities.
Apply prompt engineering techniques to improve the quality, reliability, and usefulness of AI-powered experiences.
Support implementation of Agentforce and related AI frameworks, including configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation.
Collaborate with Slalom teams across specializations such as Salesforce, data, cloud, automation, and AI to deliver integrated client solutions.
Explain Generative AI concepts, development patterns, and solution tradeoffs to internal teams and clients in a clear, practical way.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to development best practices across the team.
Help implement integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise systems, data platforms, or AI services.
Support developers and project teams in learning how to build AI-enabled applications using practical, maintainable patterns.
Work across the software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design support, development, testing, deployment, and documentation.
Plan and execute deployments with appropriate testing, coordination, and technical documentation.
What You’ll Bring
Strong Salesforce development experience across one or more Salesforce clouds.
Hands-on experience with Apex, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, APIs, and Salesforce platform development patterns.
Experience building or supporting Salesforce solutions that balance configuration, customization, automation, and code.
Exposure to Generative AI technologies and a strong interest in applying AI to enterprise business problems.
Familiarity with Agentforce, Prompt Builder, Einstein capabilities, Data Cloud, RAG patterns, or related AI-enabled Salesforce capabilities.
Ability to explain complex technical topics clearly to audiences with varying levels of technical experience.
A practical understanding of when to configure, when to customize, and when to escalate design decisions for broader architectural input.
A desire to solve difficult problems, learn emerging technologies, and deliver reliable, enterprise-ready solutions.
Ability to work collaboratively within a delivery team and contribute to shared technical outcomes.
Comfort working with ambiguity, asking thoughtful questions, and iterating toward effective client solutions.
Experience with documentation, testing, deployment planning, and development best practices.

Suggested Skills

AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI, NVIDIA NIM, Data 360 Retrievers, Search Indexes, Enterprise data grounding patterns, AI-powered prototypes or demos, AI governance, Model evaluation, Responsible AI practices, Prompt testing approaches

Slalom is seeking an experienced Enterprise AI Developer to help design, build, and implement AI-enabled solutions across Salesforce and other enterprise business applications. This role is ideal for a hands-on developer who is excited about applying Generative AI, Agentforce, automation, and modern development practices to solve meaningful client challenges.
In this role, you will work as part of cross-functional delivery teams to build proof of concepts, production-ready capabilities, integrations, and reusable patterns that help clients adopt AI responsibly and effectively. You will collaborate with architects, consultants, developers, and client stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable, maintainable technical solutions.
The ideal candidate brings strong Salesforce development experience, curiosity about emerging AI technologies, and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience with Agentforce, Prompt Builder, Data Cloud, RAG patterns, or cloud-based AI platforms is highly valued, but we also value candidates who are actively learning and applying these capabilities.
This position offers an exciting opportunity for a results-driven technologist who enjoys hands-on development, collaborative problem solving, and delivering practical AI solutions that create real business impact.
What You’ll Do
Work as a hands-on technical consultant on engagements involving AI, Salesforce, Agentforce, and other enterprise business applications.
Build and configure AI-enabled Salesforce solutions, including Agentforce capabilities, prompt-based experiences, automation, integrations, and supporting components.
Contribute as an individual developer on active client engagements, partnering closely with architects, consultants, and other developers.
Help create POCs, POVs, and reusable examples that demonstrate how AI can be applied within Salesforce and across other enterprise platforms.
Translate business requirements into well-structured technical solutions with support from solution architects and delivery leads.
Develop using Salesforce technologies such as Apex, Lightning Web Components, JavaScript, flows, APIs, and related platform capabilities.
Apply prompt engineering techniques to improve the quality, reliability, and usefulness of AI-powered experiences.
Support implementation of Agentforce and related AI frameworks, including configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation.
Collaborate with Slalom teams across specializations such as Salesforce, data, cloud, automation, and AI to deliver integrated client solutions.
Explain Generative AI concepts, development patterns, and solution tradeoffs to internal teams and clients in a clear, practical way.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to development best practices across the team.
Help implement integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise systems, data platforms, or AI services.
Support developers and project teams in learning how to build AI-enabled applications using practical, maintainable patterns.
Work across the software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design support, development, testing, deployment, and documentation.
Plan and execute deployments with appropriate testing, coordination, and technical documentation.

Strong Salesforce development experience across one or more Salesforce clouds.
Hands-on experience with Apex, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, APIs, and Salesforce platform development patterns.
Experience building or supporting Salesforce solutions that balance configuration, customization, automation, and code.
Exposure to Generative AI technologies and a strong interest in applying AI to enterprise business problems.
Familiarity with Agentforce, Prompt Builder, Einstein capabilities, Data Cloud, RAG patterns, or related AI-enabled Salesforce capabilities.

description_preview:
As an IBM Consulting FutureNow Center Intern, you will work alongside experienced professionals to help address business and technology challenges for clients around the world. This internship offers hands-on experience, opportunities to develop in-demand technical and professional skills, and the chance to contribute to meaningful client projects in a collaborative, team-based environment.
As an Intern Data Engineer, you will explore how organizations use data and enterprise technology to make better decisions, improve business processes, and develop artificial intelligence solutions. You will learn from IBM colleagues while building practical skills that can support a future career in data engineering, analytics, AI, or technology consulting.
About The Company
IBM is a global technology and consulting company that helps organizations solve complex challenges and pursue new opportunities. Through IBM Consulting, teams combine industry knowledge, technical expertise, and modern technologies to help clients transform their businesses.
IBM Consulting FutureNow Centers bring together specialists who work with public and private sector clients around the world. Within AI, Analytics, Automation and Data Services, teams help organizations modernize data platforms, develop scalable data pipelines, enable advanced analytics, automate business processes, and create AI-driven solutions designed to improve performance.
About The Role
In this internship, you will contribute to data engineering activities that help transform raw information into reliable, usable data for analytics and business applications. You will work with experienced IBM professionals and learn how data solutions are designed, developed, tested, and supported in an enterprise consulting environment.
The role is intended to provide meaningful, practical experience while helping you understand how technology teams collaborate to deliver outcomes for clients. You will have opportunities to learn about relevant tools and approaches, strengthen your analytical thinking, and build confidence communicating technical ideas. The experience may also help prepare you to pursue a potential full-time career with IBM Consulting after graduation.
Qualifications
Candidates should be currently pursuing a degree in computer science, data science, information systems, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, and should be interested in data engineering, analytics, artificial intelligence, or enterprise technology. A willingness to learn, take initiative, and work collaboratively is important.
Applicants should bring strong problem-solving and analytical skills, attention to detail, and clear written and verbal communication. Familiarity with programming concepts, databases, data structures, or data visualization is helpful. Experience with data processing tools, cloud platforms, or scripting languages may be an advantage, but a desire to develop these skills is also valued. Candidates should be comfortable receiving feedback, adapting to changing project needs, and asking questions when they encounter unfamiliar concepts.
Responsibilities
Work with project teams to understand data requirements and contribute to the development, maintenance, or improvement of data pipelines and data solutions. Assist with preparing, organizing, validating, and transforming data for use in reporting, analytics, and AI applications.
Support the exploration of data platforms, automation approaches, and emerging technologies that may address client or project needs. Help document technical processes, data definitions, findings, and project progress. Participate in testing and troubleshooting to help identify data quality issues and support dependable outcomes.
Collaborate with colleagues across technical and consulting teams, share updates, and contribute to discussions about project goals. Follow applicable guidance for data security, privacy, quality, and responsible technology use. Take part in learning activities and apply feedback to build technical and professional capabilities.
Benefits
Gain practical experience on meaningful projects and learn from experienced IBM professionals in a collaborative environment. Develop technical, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills relevant to data engineering and enterprise consulting. Explore how data, analytics, automation, and AI can support organizations, while building experience that can inform your career path after graduation.
Equal Opportunity
IBM is committed to creating an inclusive and equitable workplace. Employment decisions are made in accordance with applicable laws and company policies. IBM welcomes applicants with diverse backgrounds and experiences and considers candidates without discrimination on any protected basis under applicable law.

Description
Every day, millions of packages move through Amazon's transportation network — and this team is responsible for making sure they take the smartest, fastest, most cost-effective path to the customer's door.
Network Design Planning & Engineering sits at the center of Amazon's North American transportation strategy. We plan how packages flow from fulfillment centers to final delivery destinations, balancing speed, cost, on-time accuracy, and environmental impact. Our work directly shapes the delivery experience for hundreds of millions of customers.
We're looking for a Supply Chain Manager I who is excited about turning complex data into clear, actionable insights. In this role, you'll build the network design plans along with the key metrics to drive improvements and detect opportunities that help our team and partners see what's happening across the network — aiding better decision making. You'll work alongside experienced engineers, scientists, and product managers who will support your growth while giving you real ownership of meaningful work from day one.
Key job responsibilities
Partner with teammates across product, science, and engineering to understand what questions the business needs answered — then design and deliver the data solutions to answer them.
Build detailed network design recommendations along with maintaining interactive AI dashboards/visualizations that track how the transportation network is performing.
Conduct deep-dive analyses into operational performance, uncover root causes of issues, and recommend improvements backed by data.
Proactively look for ways to make existing reports and dashboards faster, more accurate, and easier to use.
Analyze historical trends and key lessons learned from previous experiences to surface insights that support planning and forecasting decisions.
About The Team
The Network Design, Planning and Engineering (NDPE) team supports the connectivity and flow of Amazon's transportation network through data-driven insights. We are a collaborative group of supply chain managers, data scientists and data engineers who value curiosity, knowledge sharing, and building reliable, scalable solutions. Our work directly impacts how millions of packages move through Amazon's outbound network every day. We foster a learning-focused environment where team members grow through mentorship, technical reviews, and exposure to complex, large-scale data challenges.

2+ years of program or project management experience
1+ years of supply chain experience

Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
